body:
Part 3 of same-project Rust `extract` (D-185). Depends on the command task task:4375a3b1075dced2.

**Do.**
- A moved type takes its inherent and trait `impl` blocks with it. Match an impl to the type by resolved path, not last name: moving local `Task` must not move `impl vendor::Task`; refuse an ambiguous move and name it.
- Tests that reach only moved code move, including a test inside `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`: recreate or move the container with `use super::*`, `cfg(test)` and a stable stored name. A partial move of one eligible test out of a module with staying tests works (no E5002).
- A test that uses a private helper moves with that helper: bring helpers before testing coverage.
- `selected` refuses kinds that cannot move (nested methods, `use`, `impl` rows named directly) with a clear message.
- `pub` promotion only on top-level items and inherent methods, never on trait-impl methods (E0449).

**Tests.** Struct with inherent and trait impls; same-leaf `vendor::Task` impl stays; nested test moves with its module; partial test move; helper-using test; trait-impl method used across the boundary; no new warnings (`check --warnings`).

**Out of scope.** Import carrying and E1004 namespaces (next task).
title: extract: Rust impls and test modules
